text: CI verifies each project in a job of its own, in a matrix found from the manifests on the branch, as the projects were found before, and a factory pull request's matrix is the one project it changes (D-0079). Verifying takes as long as the slowest project rather than their sum, and a new project adds no time to it. A job gathers every project's receipt and traces into the one artifact the dashboard reads, laid out as before, and invariant/gate needs every job. Each project's job gets 40 minutes, and the job of checks that verify no project 30. @gitdek chose it on 2026-09-30, the first of three options (#209).
